exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.description: Fundamental lower body compound exercise targeting quads, glutes, and hamstrings
instructions: Position barbell on upper traps, feet shoulder-width apart
Brace core and descend by breaking at hips and knees
Lower until thighs are parallel to ground
Drive through heels to return to standing
tips: Keep chest up and core tight throughout
Full depth for maximum muscle activation

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.description: Beginner-friendly squat variation holding weight at chest level
instructions: Hold dumbbell or kettlebell at chest level
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width
Squat down keeping weight at chest
tips: Keep elbows inside knees at bottom
Use as warm-up before heavier squats

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.description: Classic upper body pressing movement for chest, shoulders, and triceps
instructions: Lie on bench with eyes under the bar
Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder-width
Lower bar to mid-chest with control
Press bar back to starting position
tips: Feet flat on floor for stability

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.description: Bodyweight pulling exercise for back and arm development
instructions: Hang from bar with hands slightly wider than shoulders
Pull yourself up until chin clears bar
Lower with control to full extension
tips: Engage lats by pulling elbows down
Use resistance band for assistance if needed

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.description: Full-body compound lift focusing on posterior chain
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, bar over mid-foot
Grip bar just outside legs, hinge at hips
Keep back flat, lift by extending hips and knees
Lower bar by pushing hips back
tips: Bar should stay close to body

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: Hip-hinge movement emphasizing hamstrings and glutes
instructions: Hold barbell at hip height, slight knee bend
Push hips back while lowering bar down legs
Lower until you feel hamstring stretch
Return to start by driving hips forward
tips: Keep bar close to legs throughout
Feel stretch in hamstrings, not lower back

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.description: Vertical pressing movement for shoulders and upper body
instructions: Hold bar at shoulder height, hands shoulder-width
Brace core and press bar overhead
Lock out arms fully at top
tips: Bar path should be straight up

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.description: Horizontal pulling movement for back thickness
instructions: Bend forward at hips, grip bar shoulder-width
Keep back flat, pull bar to lower chest
Squeeze shoulder blades together at top
tips: Row to sternum, not belly button

exercises.name: Dumbbell Chest Flyes
exercises.description: Isolation exercise for chest stretch and contraction
instructions: Lie on bench with dumbbells above chest
Lower weights out to sides with slight bend in elbows
Feel stretch in chest, then return to start
Keep slight bend in elbows throughout

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.description: Rear deltoid and upper back exercise for shoulder health
instructions: Set cable at face height with rope attachment
Pull rope towards face, separating hands

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.description: Classic bicep isolation exercise
instructions: Hold bar with underhand grip, arms fully extended
Curl bar up by flexing elbows
Lower with control to full extension

exercises.name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
exercises.description: Shoulder press variation with rotation for complete deltoid development
instructions: Start with dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing you
Press up while rotating palms forward
End with arms extended, palms facing away

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.description: Single-leg squat variation for leg strength and balance
instructions: Place rear foot on bench behind you
Lower front knee until thigh is parallel
Push through front heel to stand
tips: Don't let front knee cave inward

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Upper chest focused pressing movement

exercises.name: Cable Row
exercises.description: Seated rowing movement for back thickness
instructions: Sit with feet braced, grab handle
Pull handle to torso, squeezing shoulder blades

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.description: Bodyweight exercise for chest and triceps
instructions: Descend until shoulders are below elbows
Push back up to starting position

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swings
exercises.description: Explosive hip-hinge movement for power and conditioning
instructions: Hinge at hips and swing kettlebell back
tips: Power comes from hips, not arms

exercises.name: Box Jumps
exercises.description: Explosive lower body plyometric exercise
instructions: Stand facing box at appropriate height
Swing arms and jump explosively onto box

exercises.name: Farmer Carries
exercises.description: Loaded carry for grip, core, and total body strength
instructions: Pick up heavy dumbbells in each hand

exercises.name: Barbell Thruster
exercises.description: Full-body compound movement combining front squat and push press
instructions: Hold barbell at shoulder height in front rack
As you stand, press bar overhead in one motion
Return bar to shoulders and repeat
tips: Use momentum from squat into press

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: Machine-based vertical pulling movement for back width
instructions: Sit at machine with knees secured under pad
Pull bar down to upper chest
tips: Pull with lats, not just arms

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.description: Machine-based compound lower body exercise
instructions: Sit in machine with feet shoulder-width on platform
tips: Keep lower back pressed against pad

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Overhead pressing movement with dumbbells
instructions: Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height
Press dumbbells overhead until arms extend

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
exercises.description: Bodyweight tricep isolation using bench or box
instructions: Place hands on bench behind you, legs extended
Press back up to starting position

exercises.name: Hammer Curls
exercises.description: Bicep variation with neutral grip emphasizing brachialis
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides with palms facing each other
Curl weights up keeping palms neutral
tips: Neutral grip reduces stress on wrists

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.description: Single-leg movement for leg strength and balance
instructions: Front thigh should be parallel to ground

exercises.name: Leg Curls
exercises.description: Isolation exercise for hamstrings
instructions: Lie face down on leg curl machine

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.description: Isolation exercise for calf development
instructions: Stand with balls of feet on elevated surface
Rise up onto toes as high as possible

exercises.name: Planks
exercises.description: Isometric core strengthening exercise
instructions: Start in push-up position on forearms
Keep body in straight line from head to heels
tips: Don't let hips sag or pike up

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.description: Rotational core exercise for obliques
instructions: Sit with knees bent, feet off ground
Lean back slightly, hold weight at chest
Touch weight to ground each side

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.description: Lower ab focused exercise
instructions: Lie on back with legs extended
Keep lower back pressed to floor
Raise legs until perpendicular to floor
Lower with control without touching floor
tips: Can bend knees to make easier

exercises.name: Cable Crunches
exercises.description: Weighted ab exercise using cable machine
instructions: Kneel facing cable machine with rope attachment
tips: Focus on ab contraction, not pulling with arms
Great for progressive overload on abs

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.description: Classic bodyweight pressing exercise
instructions: Start in plank position, hands shoulder-width
Lower body until chest nearly touches floor

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press
exercises.description: Lower chest emphasis pressing movement
instructions: Grip bar slightly wider than shoulders

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.description: Supported rowing movement for back thickness
instructions: Straddle T-bar with slight knee bend

exercises.name: Lateral Raises
exercises.description: Isolation exercise for side deltoids
instructions: Raise arms out to sides until parallel to floor

exercises.name: Front Raises
exercises.description: Front deltoid isolation exercise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells in front of thighs
Raise arms forward to shoulder height
Keep arms straight with slight elbow bend

exercises.name: Shrugs
exercises.description: Trap isolation exercise
instructions: Hold dumbbells or barbell at sides/front

exercises.name: Preacher Curls
exercises.description: Bicep isolation with arm support
instructions: Sit at preacher bench, arms over pad
Curl weight up with strict form

exercises.name: Skull Crushers
exercises.description: Tricep isolation exercise lying down
instructions: Lie on bench holding bar above chest
Lower bar toward forehead by bending elbows

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdowns
exercises.description: Cable-based tricep isolation
instructions: Stand at cable machine with bar at chest height
Press bar down until arms fully extended

exercises.name: Concentration Curls
exercises.description: Isolated bicep exercise for peak contraction
instructions: Sit on bench, brace elbow against inner thigh

exercises.name: Hip Thrusts
exercises.description: Glute-focused hip extension exercise
instructions: Sit on floor with upper back against bench
Drive through heels, extend hips upward

exercises.name: Good Mornings
exercises.description: Hip hinge exercise for hamstrings and lower back
instructions: Hinge forward at hips, slight knee bend

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.description: Bench press variation emphasizing triceps
instructions: Lie on bench, grip bar shoulder-width or closer

exercises.name: Cable Crossovers
exercises.description: Chest isolation using cables
instructions: Stand between cable towers, handles at shoulder height
Step forward, slight bend in elbows
Bring hands together in front of chest
tips: Adjust height for different chest areas

exercises.name: Reverse Flyes
exercises.description: Rear deltoid isolation exercise
instructions: Bend forward at hips, dumbbells hanging down

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.description: Dynamic core and cardio exercise

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.description: Full-body conditioning exercise
instructions: Jump feet to hands, then jump up

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.description: Cardio and coordination exercise
instructions: Hold rope handles at hip height
Swing rope overhead and jump as it passes under feet
Land softly on balls of feet

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.description: Squat variation with bar in front rack position, emphasizing quads
instructions: Rest bar on front of shoulders in front rack
Descend into squat keeping chest up
tips: More quad emphasis than back squat

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.description: Wide stance deadlift variation emphasizing quads and adductors
instructions: Stand with wide stance, toes pointed out
Grip bar inside legs, close stance
Keep chest up, pull bar by extending hips and knees
Lock out at top, lower with control
tips: Good for lifters with long legs
Shorter range of motion than conventional

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.description: Deadlift using hexagonal trap bar for more neutral pulling position
instructions: Stand inside trap bar, grip handles

exercises.name: Power Clean
exercises.description: Olympic lifting movement for explosive power
instructions: Start with bar at mid-shin, grip shoulder-width
Explosively extend hips and pull bar up
Drop under bar catching it on shoulders

exercises.name: Hang Clean
exercises.description: Clean variation starting from hang position above knees
instructions: Pull bar up and catch on shoulders
tips: Easier to learn than full clean

exercises.name: Snatch Grip Deadlift
exercises.description: Wide grip deadlift variation for upper back development
instructions: Longer range of motion due to wide grip

exercises.name: Deficit Deadlift
exercises.description: Deadlift standing on platform for increased range of motion
instructions: Maintain same form as regular deadlift
tips: Use less weight than regular deadlift
Great for weak off the floor

exercises.name: Pause Squats
exercises.description: Squat with 2-3 second pause at bottom for strength development
tips: Builds strength out of the hole
Use less weight than regular squats

exercises.name: Zercher Squat
exercises.description: Squat holding bar in elbow crooks for core and quad emphasis
instructions: Hold bar in crook of elbows

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
exercises.description: Single-leg bodyweight squat to full depth
instructions: Stand on one leg, other leg extended forward
Descend into full squat on one leg
tips: Hold TRX or wall for assistance

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.description: Machine squat with back support for quad isolation
instructions: Place shoulders under pads, feet on platform
Release safety, descend by bending knees
Lower until thighs parallel or below

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.description: Isolation machine exercise for quadriceps
instructions: Sit in machine, pad against lower shins

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.description: Dynamic lunge variation moving forward
instructions: Push off front leg into next lunge

exercises.name: Reverse Lunges
exercises.description: Lunge variation stepping backward
instructions: Push through front heel to return
tips: Easier on knees than forward lunges

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.description: Advanced hamstring exercise using GHD machine
instructions: Secure feet in GHD, knees on pad
Lower torso toward floor with control
Use hamstrings to pull back to start

exercises.name: Nordic Curls
exercises.description: Bodyweight hamstring exercise lowering body forward
instructions: Keep body straight, lower forward with control
Catch yourself with hands, push back up

exercises.name: Single-Leg Deadlift
exercises.description: Unilateral hip hinge for balance and hamstring development
instructions: Stand on one leg, hold weight in opposite hand
Hinge at hip, extend free leg behind
Return to standing by driving hips forward

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.description: Single-arm pressing movement using landmine setup
instructions: Hold end of landmine barbell at shoulder
Press weight up and forward in arc
tips: Easier on shoulders than vertical press
Can do single or double arm

exercises.name: Landmine Row
exercises.description: Single-arm rowing movement using landmine
instructions: Straddle landmine bar, grip end with one hand
Hinge forward, pull bar to hip

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.description: Explosive barbell row starting from floor each rep
instructions: Lower back to floor each rep

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.description: Rowing movement with chest support to isolate back

exercises.name: Seal Row
exercises.description: Lying row on elevated bench for back isolation

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.description: Bodyweight horizontal rowing using bar or rings
instructions: Hang from bar with body straight

exercises.name: Chin-ups
exercises.description: Underhand grip pull-up variation emphasizing biceps
instructions: Hang from bar with underhand grip
Lower with control to full hang

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Pull-ups
exercises.description: Pull-up with wide grip for lat width

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-ups
exercises.description: Pull-ups with added weight for progression
instructions: Attach weight via belt or hold dumbbell between feet

exercises.name: Negative Pull-ups
exercises.description: Eccentric-only pull-up for building strength
instructions: Jump or step up to top position
Lower yourself as slowly as possible

exercises.name: Paused Bench Press
exercises.description: Bench press with pause on chest for strength
instructions: Lower bar to chest as normal
tips: Use less weight than regular bench

exercises.name: Floor Press
exercises.description: Bench press variation lying on floor for tricep emphasis
instructions: Lie on floor with barbell in rack or use dumbbells
Lower bar until elbows touch floor

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.description: Chest and lat exercise with dumbbell over head
instructions: Lie across bench, dumbbell held above chest
Lower weight behind head in arc
Feel stretch in chest and lats

exercises.name: Svend Press
exercises.description: Chest squeeze press holding plates together

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press
exercises.description: Barbell press on incline for upper chest

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.description: Overhead press using leg drive for momentum
tips: Allows heavier weight than strict press

exercises.name: Overhead Pin Press
exercises.description: Partial overhead press from pins for strength
instructions: Set pins in rack at forehead height
Press bar from pins to lockout

exercises.name: Bradford Press
exercises.description: Front to back overhead press variation
instructions: Press bar from front to just overhead

exercises.name: Cuban Press
exercises.description: Rotator cuff and shoulder exercise

exercises.name: YTW Raises
exercises.description: Rear delt and upper back exercise forming Y-T-W patterns
instructions: Then T shape (arms out to sides)

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row (Close Grip)
exercises.description: Cable row with close grip for mid-back thickness
instructions: Sit at cable row with V-bar attachment

exercises.name: Meadows Row
exercises.description: Single-arm landmine row for back thickness
instructions: Hinge forward, grab bar with far hand
Pull bar to hip, rotating torso slightly

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.description: Lat isolation keeping arms straight
instructions: Stand at cable machine, arms extended overhead
Pull bar down to thighs keeping arms straight
tips: Use before or after back work

exercises.name: Cable Upright Row
exercises.description: Shoulder and trap exercise using cable
instructions: Grip cable bar at waist, hands close together
Pull bar up along body to chin level
tips: Don't pull too high if shoulder pain

exercises.name: Band Pull-Aparts
exercises.description: Rear delt and upper back exercise with resistance band
instructions: Hold band at shoulder height, arms extended
Pull band apart stretching it across chest

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
exercises.description: Bicep curl using EZ-bar for wrist comfort
tips: Easier on wrists than straight bar

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.description: Bicep curl using cable for constant tension
instructions: Stand at cable machine with bar at low position

exercises.name: Spider Curl
exercises.description: Bicep isolation with chest against incline bench

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Tricep Extension
exercises.description: Tricep isolation with overhead cable
instructions: Face away from cable, rope held overhead

exercises.name: Diamond Push-ups
exercises.description: Close-grip push-up for tricep emphasis
instructions: Get in push-up position, hands forming diamond

exercises.name: Wrist Curls
exercises.description: Forearm flexor isolation exercise
instructions: Sit with forearms on thighs, wrists hanging off

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curls
exercises.description: Forearm extensor isolation
instructions: Sit with forearms on thighs, wrists hanging off
tips: Use lighter weight than wrist curls

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.description: Hanging exercise for grip and shoulder health
instructions: Hang from bar with straight arms
